lines.text: Enoki! You're awake! Thank the fields.
The Heartstone is gone and the storm won't quit. Elder Rowan is asking for you.
His house is the one with the lantern - go on, I'll watch the road.
That's Rowan's old blade! Heh, look at you.
The meadow north of here hides bombs in the grass caves. You'll want those.
And watch the ridge - the storm up there bites. The Crypt's old stair is the only way in.
You found the Crypt's stair? Don't go dying down there, you hear?
Mara restocks her stall if you need anything. Fen keeps an eye out for bees.
Look at that - the sky's letting up! You actually did it, Enoki.
The Heartstone hums in the shrine like it never left. Village owes you a festival.
Rain's done! Done! I'm going puddle-jumping!
